note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. Conscription was still in force in 2000 and was later suspended. Italy had no operating nuclear power after the 1987 referendums; a later attempt to restart a nuclear programme was blocked by the June 2011 abrogative referendum. Catholicism is not a state religion under the 1984 revision of the Concordat, so religion-state relations are treated as pluralist secularism. Healthcare is the tax-funded national health service (Servizio Sanitario Nazionale).
